# Brand allow-list for tools/check-brand.py (CB-256, Orbweaver rebrand phase 3).
#
# One entry per line, TAB separated:   path<TAB>count<TAB>reason
#   path    forward slashes, relative to the repo root
#   count   EXACT number of lines still matching (?i)claude[ _-]?buddy after the
#           permanent tokens are masked; drift in either direction fails CI
#   reason  why the legacy name must stay (a legacy migration arm, a fixture, ...)
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# This file is generated LAST, after every phase 3 unit has merged, from
# `python tools/check-brand.py --suggest` with a real reason typed per line.
# Until then CI's brand step fails on purpose.
